description: This file defines a React Context for managing theme-related data, specifically a logo URL. It includes a custom hook for consuming the context, a provider component that loads theme settings from a backend API on mount, and manages state for the logo URL.

methods.name: useTheme
methods.description: Custom React hook to access theme context, throws an error if used outside of a ThemeProvider.

methods.name: ThemeProvider
methods.description: React functional component that initializes theme context state and fetches theme settings from backend on mount.
